pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, your fingernails grow into thick, jagged talons, unevenly matched and vaguely resembling the spurs of a giant insect or the fangs of some unspeakable beast. You gain a pair of claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks that deal 1d8 points of slashing damage if you're Medium or 1d6 points of damage if you're Small.
